subject: general
question: In a circle with radius 20 cm, X is a point located at a distance of y cm from the centre of the circle. If the length of a tangent drawn from point X to the circle is 21 cm, find the value of y.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius = 20 cm.

X is a point located at a distance of y cm from the centre of the circle.

The length of a tangent = 21 cm

**Concept used:**

The length of the hypotenuse is the length of Y

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/804b0d062d4c373cedc25a3877625e1c8bf41da1d87f4fc82eb68415b45af98e.png] 

The length of hypotaneus is the length of Y

So value of Y = √(20² + 21²)

⇒ 29 cm

**∴ The correct option is 3**
